id./param/scenario/cs/b_100_cs_150.pack|cs_: "You slew the man-eating fire dragon! Great! Hotto will never be attacked by the dragon again!
"Oh, I'm glad you're safe...! Forgive me... even for the village, to make you a sacrifice...!
"I bear no grudge against anyone... I can hold these children again. That alone makes me happy.
"Miko said sacrifice but meant to feed us to the dragon. That woman deceived us!
"Betrayed by the leader we trusted, no one is left to lead us. What will become of this village...!
"Strange. They're all adults, so why can't they think for themselves?
"...We slew the dragon thanks to this brother and... Miko too.
"What Miko did is unforgivable... But without Miko, this village would have been destroyed by the dragon long ago.
"I bet Miko suffered all along, feeling bad for us, and steeled her heart to offer sacrifices.
"Nothing binds us anymore! Heroes and gods won't help... but from now on we'll do our best ourselves!
"It may not happen right away... but from now on we'll protect the village with our own strength. It's the village I love!"
